scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/tsconfig.json && tsc -p stacks/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p runner/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.stack:deploy: dotenv -- cdk deploy --app 'pnpm tsx stacks/app.ts' --output cdk.out.stacks --require-approval never --outputs-file stack-outputs.json
scripts.stack:destroy: dotenv -- cdk destroy --app 'pnpm tsx stacks/app.ts' --output cdk.out.stacks --force
